p.s: and in my opinion travelling by yourself and by making your own plans one can enjoy better than travelling in a group led by the guide.
there are several advantages of doing so...
first one can plan there trip for how many days they want to depending on the time they have available.
second they can decide how much time they want to spend in each of the places.
they can skip places they are interested to visit similarly they can spend more time in places of interest.
moreover if i am travelling by car i can enjoy the road side beauty of nature, i can stop and spend some time at the places i find attractive on my way.
there is noone to rush me...
or my trip is not dependent on others.
certainly, if i want to leave a place in just few minutes i can even do that.
on the contrary, if you take a tour led by a guide i cant be my boss...
i have to follow the tour schedule.
which would be very difficult for me as i am a very independent person.
